quests.title: Where the Tune Came From
quests.summary: Trace the roots of an old-time tune from Ulster, Africa and the old ballads, and find a hellbender.

steps.text: Hear the old-time fiddler on State Street.
Catch a hellbendlet in the creek and show the park volunteer, then return to Granny Opal.

quests.reward: A dulcimer pick (a Storm charm), cornbread, sweet tea and standing with Kin Abroad.
